Hi Priya,

Quick one from AP as we prepare to go live with Redwood: who will be designated as the billing steward for the EU entity that issues invoices to us? Our AP team needs to know whether invoices will be created and emitted by Redwood's US billing entity (and forwarded to us), or by Redwood's EU subsidiary (local tax footprint). That determines the VAT treatment on our side.

Also: what delivery channels do you support for NordicCloud? We prefer structured e-invoice (UBL/UBL-2.1 or XML) pushed to our SFTP, but we can accept PDFs by email temporarily while portal onboarding completes. Can you confirm whether you will:
 - emit UBL/XML directly (preferred)
 - push to our SFTP OR send to finance@nordiccloud.de
 - include VAT ID and reverse-charge flags in the invoice metadata

If you can send a sample invoice (XML + PDF) and a remit template, that will speed internal sign-off. We also need the name/email of the person Redwood will list as the billing contact for contract and remittance correspondence.

Thanks,

Hi Hans — thanks for the granular questions, and great to see the preference for structured e-invoicing. Quick answers and a proposed phased approach below.

Short answers:
- Billing steward: Redwood can operate two paths. For go-live we recommend Redwood EU (Redwood Inference Europe Ltd) emit invoices for EU-sourced activity — this keeps VAT treatment straightforward. Our billing steward for NordicCloud will be: Accounting Ops (billing@redwood-eu.com) / contact: priya_natarajan@redwood.com (I'll be the day-to-day contact).
- Delivery channels: we support UBL-2.1/XML push to SFTP, portal delivery, and email PDF fallback. For immediate invoicing we can send PDFs to finance@nordiccloud.de while SFTP/portal enrollment completes.
- VAT metadata: we will include VAT ID, invoice-level taxAmounts, and a reverse-charge indicator where applicable.

Proposed plan (timelines):
1) For the first two billing cycles: Redwood EU emits PDF invoices and also attaches a machine-readable XML sample (same invoice) to speed your AP ingestion. (Temporary email push to finance@nordiccloud.de) — ETA: next invoice (within 14 days).
2) Parallel: SFTP credentials & UBL schema validation. Karthik will map our UBL fields to your ingestion format. (Target: portal/SFTP enrollment within 30 days).
3) After enrollment: switch to XML push (UBL-2.1), with a monthly PDF copy sent to finance contact for reconciliation if you want.

I attached: redwood-eu-invoice-sample.xml (example UBL + explanatory notes) and remit-instructions-template.docx (we'll edit with your IBAN/refs). Can you confirm:
- NordicCloud's VAT ID exactly as it should appear on invoices?
- preferred remit reference (PO# or customer code)?
- SFTP details OR if you prefer portal-only (we'll send DocuSign link to onboard).

If all good, I'll loop in our payments team (Mina) to set up the remit template and Connor to schedule the portal enrollment slot.

Best,

Priya / Hans — quick technical note from the integrations side.

Thanks for the sample request — couple of items to call out so the SFTP/UBL handoff is smooth:
- Our UBL skeleton follows the common UBL-2.1 elements. Key fields we populate that your parser should expect: Invoice/ID, IssueDate, Invoice/AccountingCustomerParty/Party/PartyIdentification/ID (we put the customer code there), Invoice/TaxTotal/TaxAmount, Invoice/LegalMonetaryTotal/PayableAmount, and Invoice/InvoiceLine/Item/Description. We also include Party/PartyTaxScheme/VATIdentification (as VAT-ID).
- For reverse-charge cases we set an invoice-level TaxTotal/TaxSubtotal with TaxCategory/TaxExemptionReason = "ReverseCharge" and include a textual note in Invoice/LegalMonetaryTotal/LineExtensionAmount. If your parser relies on a specific element for reverse-charge flags, tell us the element path and we can add it.
- Endpoint IDs: Some customers expect InvoiceIssuerParty/EndpointID populated with a GLN/party identifier. We currently leave EndpointID blank unless the partner requires it — we can populate that field with your GLN if you provide it.
- File naming & delivery: for SFTP upload we use filenames like REDWOOD_INV_<YYYYMMDD>_<invoiceid>.xml and a matching PDF with same invoiceid. If you need a different scheme, say so and we'll adapt.
- Retry/backfill: while portal enrollment is pending we can keep the PDF+XML pair emailed; our system will also store a 90-day backfill archive if you need re-ingestion.

Next steps for us: Hans, please share the exact VAT ID and whether you require EndpointID/GLN. Priya, once Hans confirms I'll prepare a small field-map doc and test file.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | AP Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
